patch_list: Disables optional app analytics, diagnostic collection, queued Firebase measurements, Usercentrics session pixels and Adyen analytics. Includes Hide ads. Preserves the functional API identity, travel location, consent choices, notification…

Uses 9292's native no-ad paths for Google/PubMatic, station ads and post-payment voucher promotions. Stops ad auto-initialization and advertising location publication while preserving journeys, precise location, tickets and payment outcome…
